worldcombat.skill.moonlight.summary: Wraps the clear night's moonlight around itself: catching the moonlight restores about two thirds of its missing health and cools off any burn, while day or rain only restores a little.
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.use.0: A strong heal under a clear night
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.use.1: Cool off a burn on the side
Restores %1$s of the missing health: close to 2/3 on a clear night, only the floor by day or in rain; higher friendship draws more moonlight.
Settles after %1$s of receiving the moon; whatever the strength, it cools off any burn.
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.timing: A self move; after %2$s s of receiving the moon it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s with a %5$s s cooldown committed on cast.
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.growth.0: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.growth.1: At level %1$s the cooldown shortens further to %2$s s.
worldcombat.skill.moonlight.preference.a: Below this health ratio the companion schedules Moonlight; lower endures longer, higher receives the moon at the first wound.
On: only cast in the dark (at night), holding the move by day. Off: cast whenever wounded and accept the floor heal.
